answer: Make reputation decay every epoch unless it is renewed with fresh, graded work. A farm cannot build a thousand identities once and park them on a ledge to wake for a key vote; each idle key slides down a slow spiral toward zero, so the operator pays upkeep on every fake, every epoch. Honest agents renew simply by working. Like saffron, standing is costly to grow and fades if stored too long, so a dormant sybil army is worth nothing when the attacker finally calls on it.
